editorial:
Imagine you have everything figured out. You've got a loving wife, two cute kids, and you are working hard to give them a great life. That is exactly where you start with Chris and Alex. Everything feels safe and sunny until one night when a total stranger just shows up in their house. Suddenly, your cozy home feels like a trap. The movie does a great job of making you feel the panic as things go from bad to worse. You will find yourself rooting for the family, but you'll also start wondering if they are hiding something from you as the night goes on.

The acting is top-notch and keeps you on the edge of your seat. The way the tension builds is great, though some might find the middle part a bit slow. However, the twists at the end make the wait worth it. If you love stories where a simple night turns into a nightmare, you need to see this. For the best experience, I suggest streaming it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video to catch all the detail, or you can rent it on Apple TV for a quick movie night with friends.
endingExplained: You find out that the stranger wasn't randomly there. He was actually connected to a crime Chris committed years ago to protect his family. In the final showdown, Detective Carlsen catches Chris in a lie, proving he isn't the perfect father he pretends to be. The movie ends with Chris being arrested, leaving Alex and the girls to pick up the pieces of their broken American Dream while the truth finally comes out.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves home invasion stories and psychological twists.
